name: Prep OSINT Status
Prep Schedule
Prep Health
Merge → UI panels
func:
const logo = global.get('SHAMROCK_LOGO_URI') || "data:image/png;base64,";
if (logo) global.set('SHAMROCK_LOGO_URI', logo);
const osint = (msg._cc && msg._cc.osint) || {};
const sched = (msg._cc && msg._cc.schedule) || {};
const health = msg.payload || {};
const jobs = sched.jobs || [];
const ts = new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/New_York' });
const eco = {
  leads_ok: !!(health.ok || health.service),
  osint_ready: !!osint.ready_for_scans,
  job_count: jobs.length,
  maigret: !!(osint.maigret && osint.maigret.available),
  blackbird: !!(osint.blackbird && osint.blackbird.available),
  ready: !!(osint.ready_for_scans && (health.ok || health.service)),
  ts: ts + ' ET'
};
const hero = { logo, ready: eco.ready, ts: eco.ts };
const osintPanel = {
  worker_reachable: osint.worker_reachable !== false,
  worker_url: osint.worker_url || 'http://osint-worker:5065',
  ready_for_scans: !!osint.ready_for_scans,
  maigret: !!(osint.maigret && osint.maigret.available),
  blackbird: !!(osint.blackbird && osint.blackbird.available),
  maigret_path: (osint.maigret && osint.maigret.path) || ''
};
const autoPanel = { jobs: jobs.map(j => ({
  id: j.id, cron: j.cron, tz: j.tz, path: j.path, method: j.method, desc: j.desc
})) };
const runLog = global.get('automation_run_log') || [];
const fails = runLog.filter(e => !e.ok).length;
eco.failed_runs = fails;
hero.failed_runs = fails;
node.status({fill:'green',shape:'dot',text:'updated ' + ts + (fails?(' · fails '+fails):'')});
return [
  { payload: hero },
  { payload: eco },
  { payload: osintPanel },
  { payload: autoPanel }
];
